client: a company that sells to chiropractic clinics
icp: owners of chiropractic clinics in the United States
icpSentence: Owners and clinic founders of chiropractic practices in the United States, meaning practicing chiropractors who run their own clinic, under titles such as Owner, Founder, Co-Founder, Practice Owner, Clinic Director or Doctor of Chiropractic (DC) who owns the practice. Also in the target are the people who assist or advise those owners on growing the practice, such as their executive assistants, office or practice managers, chiefs of staff, marketing and growth advisors, business coaches and consultants, and the managers of in-house or external marketing and patient acquisition teams serving them. Out are staff with no stake in marketing, sales or growth, such as billing and insurance coders, front desk reception, clinical support and therapy staff, IT, and legal or compliance, and out are owners outside chiropractic, including other healthcare or medical practices.
